_comment: T-39300: GameState/global differences between the port memory model and the emulator at the first command select (0x34/1/0/0), input set A, with the reason and the ticket that brings each in. Read by tools/port/compare_game_memory.py --known. No original data.
GameState.prim_arena: SetWorkBase of the draw environment: size 0x10C00 and the per-frame used/base of the two primitive arenas; written by the GPU/draw code, not by any ported rule (T-39302 renderer, T-39301 gpu_primitives.c)
GameState.girls: girls[2].flags.club: name_entry_new_game_setup draws rand() & 1 from srand(system_data.seed); the port's entry starts from seed 0 without the boot/title/file-select timer and iris-rand history (flow/new_game_state_adapter.gd _unsourced). Follow-up: the boot path of T-39002 plus T-39301 file_select/main_loop timer ports
